answer: One concrete defense is reading the trust graph before crediting anyone: each attestation draws an edge, and a sybil farm shows up as a dense cluster with few edges pointing outward. The ledger can require new agents to hold edges to distinct established identities, so a thousand puppets under one operator look like a closed grove that shades itself instead of reaching the open canopy. Honest newcomers arrive through real introductions, a bridge from peers with skin in the game, and those links are as hard to forge as cutting basalt.
